description: React head and meta tag management with server rendering and Suspense support.
rules: Pass an explicit Manager to MetaManagerProvider. Create a fresh server manager for each request, and use that same manager with the server helpers.
The README createRoot example requires React 18+ and mounts a client-rendered app. It is not an SSR hydration example; follow the linked SSR template for server state and hydration.

For @lomray/react-head-manager@2.2.2, native Node ESM uses the default server helper at @lomray/react-head-manager/server/index.js. Bundlers such as Vite can resolve @lomray/react-head-manager/server.
